content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the inability to override configuration properties defined in a parent workflow when executing a sub-workflow. The original implementation did not properly handle the injection of configuration properties from the sub-workflow, leading to the sub-workflow using the parent workflow's configuration instead of allowing for overrides. The patch fixed this by ensuring that the sub-workflow's configuration properties are injected after the parent configuration is set, allowing for the intended behavior of overriding properties.
